**Every App trust boundaries** (docs/threat-model.md is the model; it names each boundary's invariants and the code that holds them):

- An app route, server function or tool that trusts an inbound `x-everyapp-*`, `cf-access-*`, `Cookie` or `Authorization` header before the perimeter (`packages/perimeter/src/gateway.ts`, `headers.ts`) stripped it, or code that forwards one of them to an app
- Identity read without the SDK's pinned verification (`packages/sdk/src/internal/identity.ts`): an audience other than the Worker's name, the dev key or dev issuer accepted outside `EVERYAPP_DEV`, an MCP call identity minted with `*` scopes or reused across calls
- A route on the Gateway's own host that reads the session cookie on a state-changing request without the same-origin guard (`apps/every-app-gateway/src/server/control-plane-guard.ts`), a Better Auth endpoint newly open over HTTP (`disabledPaths` in `src/auth/config.ts`), or a server function that acts outside the caller's organization or role
- A Gateway call to a provider (the AI proxy, the capability proxy, email, members) or to an app that is not attributed to an organization, skips the manifest's grant, follows a redirect, or lets an app's own `Authorization`, `x-api-key` or cookies reach the provider; a provider key or Worker secret reaching an app, a log line, an error message or a client
- The deploy policy (`packages/cli/src/lib/app/policy.ts`, `apps/every-app-gateway/src/server/deploy/metadata.ts`) accepting a route, `workers_dev`, a preview URL, a binding to another Worker or namespace, a secret, a cron, an email trigger or a helper Worker the manifest doesn't declare; a registry write that bypasses `@every-app/perimeter/registry`; anything on the public Worker that accepts a registration, deploy or delete on self-host
- `/mcp`: a tool callable without a per-call identity carrying `mcp:` scopes, a write or destructive tool reachable by a read-only caller, a browser caller admitted from another origin, an OAuth access token accepted on an app host, a redirect URI or client id on the platform's own domains, a consent decision taken without the same-origin form POST
- Hosted-only behaviour (shared apps, the dispatch tier, the deploy API, open sign-up) reachable in `self_hosted` mode, or a switch in `platformPolicy()` that fails open on a missing or invalid `GATEWAY_DEPLOYMENT_MODE`
- Cloudflare Access: an assertion trusted without JWKS verification of its signature, issuer, AUD, expiry and `type: "app"`; a session honoured behind the outer ring without a verified assertion for the same person; the apps' application's AUD signing someone in on the Gateway's host
- Third-party hosts: a dispatch row served on a first-party host or the reverse; `__Host-everyapp_s` or a handoff code accepted without the host, app-row, nonce and single-use checks; an app response's `Set-Cookie` with a `Domain`, or named `__Host-everyapp_*`, let through
- The CLI: a secret value on a command line, in a log file, in `--json` output or in an error; a deploy that builds or runs a repository fetched from a URL; a tarball entry that escapes its directory
